title: MEX Replacement
statement: Given a multiset of non-negative integers in compressed form (n ≤ 2·10^5 distinct values x_i ≤ 10^9 with counts y_i ≤ 10^9), an operation replaces any non-empty sub-collection by its MEX. It asks for the largest integer that can ever appear. Building K needs all of 0..K-1 at once, and each missing value doubles the required count, so the answer exceeds max x by at most about 50.
